package argojob
import("encoding/json";"os";"path/filepath";"testing")
func TestExportIsolationControllerInputs(t *testing.T){
 for _,shape:=range []string{"dedicated-tools","none","container","script","containerset","sidecars","inline-dag","inline-steps"}{
  wf,err:=Build(testConfig(),isolationControllerRequest(t,shape));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  b,err:=json.MarshalIndent(wf,"","  ");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("OBERTH_ISOLATION_PROOF_DIR"),shape+"-workflow.json"),b,0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
}
